entities.name: Augusto Ulloa y Castañón
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Augusto Ulloa y Castañón was a Spanish lawyer, politician and journalist who served twice as Minister of State, in 1871, during the reign of King Amadeo I, and in 1874, under the presidency of Francisco Serrano, 1st Duke of la Torre, in the First Spanish Republic.
